subject: Biology
title: Reproductive Health
summary: Reproductive health (WHO) ka matlab reproduction ke har pehlu mein poori bhalaai — physical, emotional, behavioural aur social. India national family planning (1951) shuru karne wale pehle deshon mein tha, baad mein ise RCH (Reproductive and Child Health Care) programmes mein badhaaya gaya.

Contraceptive methods: natural, barrier, IUD, oral pills, injectables/implants aur surgical (sterilisation). Ideal contraceptive user-friendly, aasaani se milne wala, effective, reversible aur kam side effects wala hota hai.
Medical termination of pregnancy (MTP) India mein tay conditions mein legal hai (MTP Amendment Act, 2017). Prenatal amniocentesis se sex jaanna banned hai.
Sexually transmitted infections (STI) aur infertility badi chintaayein hain; assisted reproductive technologies (ART) jaise IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI, AI aur IUI infertile couples ki madad karti hain.

formulas.name: Natural methods
formulas.formula: periodic abstinence (days 10–17 of cycle);  withdrawal (coitus interruptus);  lactational amenorrhea (up to 6 months after parturition with full breastfeeding)
formulas.mistake: Inka failure rate zyada hai — bharosa mat karo.

formulas.name: Barrier methods
formulas.formula: condoms (male — 'Nirodh'; female), diaphragms, cervical caps, vaults (reusable) + spermicidal creams/jellies
formulas.when: Sperm aur ovum ko milne se rokna.
formulas.note: Condoms STIs aur AIDS se bhi bachaate hain.

formulas.name: IUD types
formulas.formula: non-medicated (Lippes loop);  copper-releasing (CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375);  hormone-releasing (Progestasert, LNG-20)

formulas.name: How IUDs work
formulas.formula: increase phagocytosis of sperm in the uterus;  Cu ions suppress sperm motility and fertilising capacity;  hormone IUDs make the uterus unsuitable for implantation and the cervix hostile to sperm

formulas.name: Oral pills
formulas.formula: progestogens or progestogen–oestrogen combinations; taken daily for 21 days starting within the first 5 days of the cycle;  inhibit ovulation and implantation, alter cervical mucus;  Saheli (non-steroidal, once a week, CDRI Lucknow)

formulas.name: Emergency contraception
formulas.formula: progestogens or progestogen–oestrogen combinations, or IUDs, within 72 hours of coitus

formulas.name: Surgical methods
formulas.formula: vasectomy (part of vas deferens removed/tied);  tubectomy (part of fallopian tube removed/tied)
formulas.note: Bahut effective hain par reversibility kharab hai.

formulas.name: MTP
formulas.formula: safe in the first trimester (up to 12 weeks);  MTP Amendment Act 2017: up to 12 weeks with one registered medical practitioner's opinion, 12–24 weeks with two

formulas.name: STIs
formulas.formula: gonorrhoea, syphilis, genital herpes, chlamydiasis, genital warts, trichomoniasis, hepatitis B, HIV/AIDS;  hepatitis B, genital herpes and HIV are not completely curable

formulas.name: ART methods
formulas.formula: IVF + ET (test-tube baby): ZIFT — zygote or early embryo (up to 8 blastomeres) into fallopian tube;  IUT — embryo with more than 8 blastomeres into uterus;  GIFT — ovum from donor into fallopian tube;  ICSI — sperm injected into ovum;  AI/IUI — semen into vagina or uterus

formulas.name: Amniocentesis
formulas.formula: testing cells in amniotic fluid for genetic disorders; misused for foetal sex determination — legally banned in India

examples.title: Kaunsi ART?
examples.problem: Ek mahila ova nahi bana sakti par fertilisation ke liye sahi environment de sakti hai. Kaunsa method?
examples.solution: GIFT — donor ka ovum uski fallopian tube mein daala jaata hai.

examples.title: Kam sperm count
examples.problem: Pati ka sperm count bahut kam hai. Kaunsi ART sabse sahi?
examples.solution: Pati ya donor ke semen se artificial insemination (AI) ya intra-uterine insemination (IUI); agar sperm khud fertilise na kar paayein to ICSI.

examples.title: ZIFT vs IUT
examples.problem: ZIFT aur IUT mein kya farak hai?
examples.solution: ZIFT: zygote ya 8 blastomeres tak ka embryo fallopian tube mein. IUT: 8 se zyada blastomeres wala embryo uterus mein.

examples.title: Lactational amenorrhea kyun kaam karta hai
examples.problem: Zyada breastfeeding ke dauraan ovulation kyun nahi hota?
examples.solution: Parturition ke baad intense lactation mein ovulation aur menstrual cycles nahi hote; ye sirf janm ke lagbhag chhe mahine tak effective hai.

examples.title: Saheli
examples.solution: Ye non-steroidal oral contraceptive hai jo hafte mein ek baar li jaati hai, Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI), Lucknow ne banayi.

examples.title: STIs se bachav
examples.problem: STIs se bachne ke aasaan tareeke batao.
examples.solution: Anjaan ya kai partners ke saath sex se bacho; hamesha condoms use karo; shak hone par jaldi doctor se milo taaki jaldi pata chale aur poora ilaaj ho.

topics.title: Reproductive health problems and strategies
topics.explain: Programmes reproduction se jude pehluon ki jaagrukta, schools mein sex education, birth control, pregnant maaon ki dekhbhaal, post-natal care, breastfeeding ki ahmiyat, ladke-ladkiyon ko barabar mauke par dhyan dete hain. Safal kadam: maternal aur infant mortality kam, chhote parivaar, STDs ka behtar pata aur ilaaj.

topics.title: Population explosion
topics.explain: Duniya ki aabadi 1900 mein lagbhag 2 billion aur 2011 ke aas-paas 7.2 billion se zyada thi. India ki aabadi aazaadi ke samay lagbhag 350 million aur 2011 tak 1.2 billion se zyada. Kaaran: death rate, maternal mortality rate (MMR) aur infant mortality rate (IMR) ka girna, aur reproducible age mein zyada log. Shaadi ki kanooni umar badhaayi — females 18 saal aur males 21.

topics.title: Contraceptives and side effects
topics.explain: Sambhavit side effects: nausea, pet dard, breakthrough bleeding, irregular menstrual bleeding aur breast cancer tak — isliye doctor ki salah se hi use karo.

topics.title: Why MTP is needed
topics.explain: Casual intercourse ya contraceptive fail hone se anchaahi pregnancy rokne ke liye, ya jab pregnancy jaari rakhna maa ya foetus ke liye nuksaandeh ho. Galat use: illegal female foeticide; ayogya jhola-chhaap illegal MTPs ko unsafe banate hain.

topics.title: Infertility
topics.explain: Unprotected sexual cohabitation ke baad bhi conceive na kar paana; kaaran physical, congenital, bimaariyan, drugs, immunological ya psychological, aur kisi bhi partner mein ho sakte hain. Specialised health clinics kuch disorders ka pata aur ilaaj karte hain. ART ki kamiyaan: bahut precise handling, specialised professionals aur mehnge instruments/reagents chahiye, isliye kuch hi centres mein milti hai aur kam log afford kar paate hain; success pakki nahi — early embryo survive na kare, aisa ho sakta hai; emotional, religious aur social factors bhi rokte hain. Anaath aur besahara bachchon ko legally adopt karna sabse achhe vikalpon mein se ek hai.

topics.title: Complications of untreated STIs
topics.explain: Pelvic inflammatory diseases (PID), abortions, still births, ectopic pregnancies, infertility aur reproductive tract ka cancer tak.

ratta: Copper IUDs: CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375;  hormonal: Progestasert, LNG-20.
Pills: 21 days, start in first 5 days;  Saheli weekly (CDRI).
MTP safe in first trimester (12 weeks).
ZIFT ≤ 8 blastomeres → tube;  IUT > 8 → uterus;  GIFT donor ovum → tube.
Hep B, herpes, HIV not fully curable.
ART limits: costly instruments + specialised experts, few centres, early embryo may not survive;  alternative = legal adoption of orphans.
